issues.claim: measured_outcomes: the 2020 Journal of Imaging system 'estimated rubbing duration within 2.20-2.39 seconds'
issues.problem: Source Table 8 is titled 'Average mis-prediction in seconds' (2.39 for rub-without-water, 2.20 for rub-with-water), against ground-truth mean durations of 16.40 s and 13.72 s (Table 9). The number is right, but read quickly the sentence implies rubbing lasted ~2.2 s, which is wrong by roughly 7x. Two other places in avenue.json say it correctly ('roughly 2-second duration error'), so this is a wording slip, not bad data.
issues.fix: Restate as 'estimated rubbing duration to within 2.20-2.39 s of ground truth (ground-truth means 13.7-16.4 s)'.

issues.claim: pilot.cost_range arithmetic: '$1,302 ... add an unpriced allowance of roughly $200-500 ... giving about $1,300-1,800 of hardware' and 'so the sum is about $4,300-10,550'
issues.problem: Internal arithmetic is loose: $1,302 + $200 = $1,502, so the hardware band should read ~$1,500-1,800, not ~$1,300-1,800; the later sum then computes to ~$4,500-10,550, not $4,300-10,550. The final published range ($4,500-11,000 one-time) still covers the correct figure, so nothing is overstated.
issues.fix: Use $1,500-1,800 for hardware and $4,500-10,550 for the pre-rounding sum, keeping the $4,500-11,000 headline.

issues.claim: Buyer-turnover evidence: 96% (full service) / 135% (limited service) hourly turnover, Q3 2024, Black Box Intelligence
issues.problem: Cited URL (blackboxintelligence.com/news/state-of-restaurant-workforce-2024) returns HTTP 403 on re-check, and Black Box's 2024 PDF upload is 2021-era data, so the figure could not be read on Black Box's own page. It is corroborated by trade press: FEr (fermag.com) reports 135% limited-service hourly turnover in Q3 2024 and full-service hourly turnover 'below 100%' in Q3.
issues.fix: Add the FEr article as a second citation, or re-cite the Black Box release with a note that the primary page blocked retrieval.

issues.claim: Bare-hand-contact exception applies only to establishments not serving a highly susceptible population (N.J.A.C. 8:24-3.3(a)4)
issues.problem: Confirmed in the rule text, but 3.3(a)4's training-documentation list in the published text is numbered (1), (3), (4), (5) - there is no (2) - so an operator quoting avenue's 'three items' framing may be asked why the rule looks incomplete.
issues.fix: No change needed to the substance; optionally note that the codified list is numbered (1),(3)-(5) in the published text.
